Each row's tests rank first for that module (after the hand-pinned rows); the builder
fills any remaining slot from its static ranking. Rows come from a per-test line-coverage
run over the not-slow tests of the IO, capture, record, replay, visualization and validation
territories: a greedy cover of the module's function-body lines executed by those tests.
A stale row (renamed module or test, empty reason) stops the build; regenerate or delete it.
